t: What is said to a soul at the end
a: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
p: Yā ayyatuha-n-nafsu-l-muṭma'innah, irjiʿī ilā rabbiki rāḍiyatan marḍiyyah…
m: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul, Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], And enter among My [righteous] servants And enter My Paradise."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
